verdict.rationale: Helicone's webhooks docs name real-time evaluation of live LLM responses as a supported use case: they say webhooks fire when requests complete so you can "score responses" and "automatically score and evaluate LLM responses for quality, safety, and relevance." Property filters let you target a subset of production traffic. However, the evaluator logic appears to run in the user's own external system that receives the webhook, not as a native online-evaluator feature. Missing for 10: native first-party evaluators that run on production traffic, configurable evaluator types and sampling, eval score storage and dashboards in Helicone, and independent or hands-on corroboration of online evals.
